about: The story cast (the owner, 2026-10-23: 'each one in another suit colour, hair and eyes, each one markets a different product, like Ravit recommends'). Original animated characters, AI-labelled everywhere, no brand names or logos on the clothes, no jewellery drawn (the product is always its real photo). Each one in her own athleisure outfit from the owner's references (2026-10-23): an oversized cropped hoodie with joggers, a sports bra with full-length striped leggings, a cropped collared sweatshirt with sweatpants. Always long pants, plain fabric, never a logo or letters.
person: original young woman fitness model character, {hair}, {eyes}, bright friendly smile, fit healthy figure
negative: jewelry, earrings, necklace, bracelet, ring, watch, text, logo, brand name, letters on clothes, emblem, small logo on chest, print on clothes, shorts, hot pants, briefs, bikini, underwear, bare legs, bare thighs, exaggerated body, large breasts
